verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents order/payment lifecycle tracking, webhooks for standard checkout orders, order-intent accounting (total/reserved/spent/available), decline-reason surfacing, and chargeback/dispute handling under an authorization-hold model that mirrors normal card processing — all of which support reconciliation for merchants receiving agent-originated card payments. However, the agent-checkout flow itself (agents buying from 'any merchant') explicitly has no webhooks in v1 and no staging environment, relying on polling only, and no agent-specific payout/settlement report or merchant reconciliation dashboard is documented. Missing for 10: agent-checkout webhook/event support, a merchant-facing payout/settlement report specific to agent transactions, and independent confirmation that reconciliation works as described.
